title: Occupancy, Vacancy and Vacancy Permit Conditions of the LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy
content:
## Reporting occupancy

On the LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy the landlord reports when the building becomes vacant, and the vacancy start date is recorded as the first day without a tenant in residence. The landlord also reports when a tenant moves in, which clears the vacancy start date. A building under renovation with no tenant is vacant.

## Vacancy permits

A vacancy permit suspends the vacancy exclusion for the period it states. It is issued only on a tier on which a vacancy permit is available (every LandlordGuard tier except DP-1 Basic), for no more than the tier's longest vacancy permit, starting no earlier than the date it is requested and never retroactively.

A vacancy permit starts no earlier than the date the landlord requests it. The request date rests on the landlord's statement, and the permit start is the date recorded on the policy.

| Hypothetical request | Permit start asked for | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| requested on 10 May | 10 May | starts on the request date |
| requested on 10 May | 20 May | starts after the request date |
| requested on 10 May | 1 May | retroactive — not issued |

## Retired clause

The former clause on the permit charge — the term premium multiplied by the tier's vacancy permit rate, by the permit days and divided by the calendar days in the term, rounded half-up to the cent, posted as one additional premium entry for the vacancy permit dated the permit start — is **no longer in force**. It has been superseded by the current basis for the vacancy permit charge.

## Lease type

A lease type the tier does not accept, including any short-term rental on a tier that does not list short-term rentals, makes the building ineligible. The landlord must return to an accepted lease type, or the policy is nonrenewed for ineligible occupancy at the next renewal.

superseded_clauses: The permit charge is term_premium multiplied by vacancy_permit_rate_pct, by the permit days and divided by the calendar days in the term, rounded half-up to the cent, posted as one dwelling_additional_premium entry with change_reason vacancy_permit dated the permit start.
